note: Defects earlier judges and challengers found in ports of this block. The acceptance script must have a compared check that fails on a port with each one; list those keys in checks.

defects.defect: repeat-press-loading / focus retention: a mouse click never leaves focus on the button. The inner motion.span carries tabindex="-1" (LoadingButton.vue line ~145, also on the check motion.path), so the click focuses that span, and when the span is swapped out focus drops to BODY. Measured after a real mouse click on Subscribe: document.activeElement = BODY during loading, success and idle (original and Svelte: BUTTON in all three). The sampler shows focus=false on the Vue button in every mouse run (subscribe, pay, apply, hold-press), focus=true in the original.

keyboard-activate: consequence of the above. After clicking Subscribe with the mouse and waiting for idle, pressing Space starts a new cycle in the original (aria-busy at +18ms, Subscribed at +1418ms) and in Svelte, but does nothing in Vue (no state change over 4s). Keyboard activation works in Vue only when focus arrived by Tab.

success-subscribe: the check mark is never drawn with motion enabled. The check path's computed stroke-dasharray stays '0px, 1px' for the whole 2000ms success state (original and Vue go 0 > 1px in about 285ms). Screenshots loading-button-svelte-x-3-success.png and loading-button-svelte-4-subscribe-success.png show only a dot left of 'Subscribed'. Under reduced motion the check is drawn (dasharray '1px, 1px').

success-sticky: same bug on Pay. 'Paid' is shown with a dot instead of a check and it stays that way indefinitely (loading-button-svelte-8-pay-paid.png, loading-button-svelte-12-end.png, taken many seconds after success).

shrink-loading (expand back): the port springs border-radius in px from 999 to 6, so the button stays a full pill for about 400ms after success/error (radius 330px at +150ms, 64px at +283ms, below the 20px clamp only at about +380ms, 6px at +530ms). The original sets the radius immediately: 6px vertical ('15%') from the first frame of the expansion. Visible in loading-button-svelte-x-3-success.png (pill) versus loading-button-orig-x-3-success.png (6px corners) at the same moment. Note the checklist text asks for an animated radius; the original does not do that.

press-scale (release): on release the scale first moves the wrong way, 0.970 > 0.954 (about 50ms after release) before returning to 1; original and Vue return monotonically 0.970 > 1. Same thing on a quick click: a brief 1.003 to 1.004 blip. Small (about 6px on the full-width Pay button) but measured on every release (hold on idle Subscribe, idle Pay and Paid).

tab-order: extra Tab stop on the decorative check-mark <path> whenever a success state is showing. With Pay on 'Paid' (sticky), Tab from the email input gives input > Subscribe > Paid button > path > Apply code > body; the original gives input > Subscribe > Paid button > Apply code. Reproduced in three separate runs (S6 focusBefore 'path:', S8 tabInSuccess and tabInLoading). The path has no tabindex attribute (outerHTML identical to the original's, tabIndex -1), so the likely cause is motion-v attaching focus listeners to motion.path, which makes an SVG element focusable in Chrome. Screenshot loading-button-vue-21-tab-in-success.png shows a focus ring drawn around the check icon.

keyboard consequence of the same defect: after activating Pay with Enter, Tab then Enter does not reach Apply code. Focus is on the path, Enter produces a click on button index 1 (Pay) which re-runs Pay, and focus then drops to BODY when the path unmounts (kbEnterApply: events keydown/click on btn 1, focusAfter 'BODY'). In the original the same keys land on Apply code and run its error cycle (busy at +14ms, 'Code expired' at +1013ms, idle at +3013ms).

shrink-loading: the width animation first moves the wrong way. On click the button snaps from 98.3px to 39.6px within one frame (+21ms), then GROWS to about 77px at +170ms and only then shrinks back to 40px, settling at about +505ms. The original shrinks monotonically 97.7 > 40 (67.5px at +129ms, settled +395ms). Same on Apply code (108 > 39.8 at +22ms > 82.7 at +172ms > 40 at +505ms) and on keyboard activation.

success-subscribe: the expansion runs backwards. At success (+1404ms) the button jumps to 128px, then shrinks to 40px over about 500ms while showing 'Subscribed' (label clipped), and snaps to the final 131px at about +1971ms. The original grows 40 > 130 monotonically, settled by +1812ms. Screenshot loading-button-svelte-05-subscribe-success.png (taken +1900ms) shows a 40px button with the text cut to 'Subscr'; the original at the same moment shows the full 'Subscribed' button.

success-subscribe / return to idle: after the reset the button does not come back to its idle width. Width goes 131 > 169 > 122 > ... > 32px and is still 32px at the end of the recording (+4300ms, 880ms after the reset); the next cycle 3.9s later starts from 40px and again ends at 32.2px. Original ends at 97.75px. Screenshot loading-button-svelte-06-subscribe-idle.png shows a 32px-wide Subscribe button with clipped text 'ubscri'.

error-state: same broken width curve on Apply code. At the error (+1005ms) the button jumps to 119px, shrinks to 40px by about +1540ms with 'Code expired' clipped, then snaps to 121.6px at about +1590ms; after the reset it collapses to 34.3px (wEnd 34.27 at +3700ms; original 107.3px). In the re-click run it only snapped back to 108px about 570ms after the reset.
